description: Extension Mechanism -> Aggregation Extension: "A test case whose graders are *all* null-scored has no basis for a pass/fail verdict; runners MUST report such a case's passed as false". Every GraderResult here is correctly null/false (e.g. a human review still pending), but Result.passed is true. The raw JSON Schema cannot express this cross-item rule and accepts the document; the reference validators reject it (UNSCORED_RESULT_PASSED). A conformance implementation MUST REJECT this document. The same Result with passed: false is valid (see null_score_not_scored_failure.json).
